title.narrative: Support the Development of Youth-led SMEs

description.narrative: The contract will support business creation, medium and small enterprises growth and youth employment. The intervention will address existing support gaps alongside the entrepreneurship journey. This will increase the creation and growth of youth-led MSMEs, with a strong emphasis on inclusion of young women and persons with disabilities.
